name: The Kovenant
description: '''The Kovenant''' is a Norwegian [[industrial metal]] band from [[Hamar]]. The band formed as [[symphonic black metal]] act '''Covenant''' in 1993, but changed their name to The Kovenant in 1999 due to a dispute with a [[Covenant (band)|Swedish band of the same name]]. The name change marked a change in style. The band focused on a [[cyber metal|cyber]]/[[industrial metal]] sound influenced by Europe's [[Electronic body music|EBM]] scene. The Kovenant later reissued their early albums under The Kovenant name.
